subject: StonePay SDK onboarding: sandbox warmup, sample snippets, and rate harmonization
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@stonepay.com>, Katy Lin <katy@stonepay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: StonePay SDK onboarding: sandbox warmup, sample snippets, and rate harmonization

Hi Sandeep / Katy —

Quick summary and proposed plan for the SDK onboarding window this week. Objective: get StonePay's sandbox traffic exercising Redwood endpoints, validate prefix/KV caching behavior, and converge on retry/timeout and rate settings before staging cutover.

Proposed 48–72 hour warmup steps (high level):
- Sandbox SDK install: use the attached zip for language samples (node/python/curl). See README inside for quick start.
- Warmup traffic: start with short bursts (100 req/min) and ramp over 24h to steady-state (target 600 req/min) while we monitor latency & 5xx.
- Endpoint migration plan: point sandbox to sandbox.redwood-inference.net/v1/sdkgateway initially, then switch to sandbox.redwood-inference.net/v1/production-style endpoint during smoke test. We will coordinate the DNS/IP cutover window.
- Retries & timeouts: recommended defaults included below; we suggest conservative settings during ramp: 3 retries (exponential backoff starting at 150ms), per-request timeout 10s, per-connection keepalive 60s.
- Rate harmonization: we provided a recommended token-level bucket in the attached rate-profile CSV; Redwood will apply soft-rate fencing for the first 48h to avoid noisy neighbor spikes.

Immediate asks for StonePay:
1) Confirm a 2-hour maintenance window for Wednesday 12/23 between 10–12 PT for the staging cutover.
2) Share the sandbox API key you want us to whitelist (or confirm we'll use the temporary key in the MAP spreadsheet).
3) Let us know preferred SDK language (node or python) so we can tailor the kickoff demo.

Attached: stonepay-sdk-examples.zip (samples + README), mutual-action-plan-stonepay.xlsx (timeline), rate-profile-stonepay.csv (bucket params).

If helpful, Vanessa and I can do a 30–60 minute pairing session to walk through the sample app and instrument the telemetry.

Thanks,
Mateo
Senior CSM, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@stonepay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Katy Lin <katy@stonepay.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StonePay SDK onboarding: sandbox warmup, sample snippets, and rate harmonization

Thanks Mateo — this looks solid. A couple quick clarifications before we lock in the window:
- The 3 retries you recommend: are those client-side only, or should our gateway also retry on 502/503? Our infra team prefers to keep retries on the client side to avoid duplicate work.
- For the warmup ramp, is 600 req/min per instance or aggregated? Our sandbox will spin up 2 app instances initially.
- Can you confirm what metric we'll use to declare the warmup "healthy" (p95 latency threshold/5xx rate)?

We can do the Wednesday 10–12 PT window; prefer a 60-minute pairing session that includes a short smoke test. We'll use Node first. I'll share the sandbox API key to your teams (secure channel) after we confirm the small details above.

—Sandeep
Head of Platform Engineering, StonePay

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@stonepay.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Katy Lin <katy@stonepay.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: StonePay SDK onboarding: sandbox warmup, sample snippets, and rate harmonization

Thanks — this is great and exactly what we needed. Confirming: 60-minute session on Wednesday 12/23 10:00–11:00 PT. We'll start with the Node sample and follow the ramp schedule you suggested.

I'll send the sandbox API key to your security mailbox and share the internal CIDR for whitelist. Also flagged the MAP spreadsheet with our preferred cutover owner (Katy).

See you Wednesday.

Sandeep
Head of Platform Engineering, StonePay
